These commands are available three ways — in the FREE-WILi GUI app, in a serial
terminal, and on the device itself. See
[Connecting it to a computer](../start-here/connecting.md) for how to reach them.

## Software Reset

Performs a software reset of the device.

**How to use it** — press `1`.

## Reset To Bootloader

Resets the device into the USB bootloader.

**How to use it** — press `2`.

## All Settings To Defaults

Restores all settings to their default values.

**How to use it** — press `3`.
